hint.env: The .env from the Andon configurator. View, write secret, content key and key version are taken; the invite secret is dropped, a source does not pair devices.
hint.envPrefix: Empty: the values above are used. ANDON_ or ANDON_CLOUD_: whatever is empty above is read from <prefix>VIEW, <prefix>WRITE_SECRET, <prefix>CONTENT_KEY, <prefix>KEY_VERSION and <prefix>URL - for a Node-RED that is configured by its container.
hint.kv: Empty: 1, or <prefix>KEY_VERSION with a prefix set.
hint.template: A view document from the configurator. It fixes titles, icons, units, ranges and bands; its values are start values.
hint.tiles: msg.topic is the tile ID. Tick a tile to derive its status from its bands.
hint.interval: At most one upload per interval, 10 s at least.
hint.window: Keep the last n points of a series, and nothing older than the age. 0 switches a limit off.

import.pick: The file holds several views. Which one?
import.none: No complete view in this file.
import.otherRelay: This .env belongs to __url__; this Node-RED talks to __relay__. Not imported.
